strings.دروس تشطيب البيت في الكويت 3: اكتب نطاق: Home finishing lessons in Kuwait 3: define the scope before comparing quotations
strings.وصلك عرضان لتشطيب البيت وأسعارهما مختلفة: You have received two offers for finishing the house and their prices are different? The first step is to make sure that they describe the same work. Only the word “comprehensive” explains the spaces, materials and processing and does not take over the overlapping items. In the third lesson of the Almusaileem series of paint and decoration, we turn the file of your needs and plans into a practical list that helps you request a presentation and discuss it before the agreement.
strings.تصميم توضيحي لمخطط بيت وملف مشروع وعينات: Explanatory design of a house planner, project file, materials samples and measuring tape on a table
strings.تصميم توضيحي مولّد بالذكاء الاصطناعي، ول: AI-generated illustration, not a photograph of a completed Almusaileem project.

strings.ارجع إلى مخرجات الدرسين السابقين: استخدا: Refer to the output of the previous two lessons: using the rooms, what will remain and what will change, and the schemes reviewed by the specialists. If a decision still affects the quantity or material, clearly write it down. Do not ask the authorities to price different assumptions and then compare the total like an equal comparison. Separate clarification can be requested for items that need a preview or additional appropriation.
strings.اكتب البند كأنه تعليمات قابلة للفهم: Write the item as understandable instructions.
strings.لكل بند حدّد المكان والأسطح أو العناصر ا: For each item specify the place and surfaces or elements covered, the agreed measurement method, the required processing, the reference of the material and the sample. In the paint for example, explain whether the ceiling is inside the range, and whether there are weak layers or wallpaper needs to be processed. In cladding, record the wall and its limits, edges and angles, openings and elements that need access for maintenance.
strings.ضرورة تماسك السطح ونظافته وجفافه وفق متط: The surface should be smooth, clean and dry according to product requirements. This is an example that the processing item is part of the work description, not just a color selection. The actual processing and layering system are determined after examining the surface and returning to the selected material leaflet.
strings.افصل المشمول عن المستثنى: Separate the included from the excluded
strings.اكتب من يوفر المواد ومن يركبها، ومن يحمي: Write down who saves the material and who installs it, who protects the asset and cleans up its scope residues. Specify responsibility for removing old items if required, and conduction and modification work that needs a specialist. Do not assume that the gypsum width includes luminaires, or that the width of the cladding includes the transmission of power points. Clarity of these limits helps each party prepare their commitment before the start.
strings.البرايمر والمعجون وما يجب توضيحه في العر: Primer and putty and what to explain in the presentation
strings.لفهم أثر المساحة وحالة السطح. هذي مراجع: To understand the impact of the area and the condition of the surface. These are references to specific items, while our study combines the scope of the whole project into a unified request.
strings.راجع كل عرض مقابل قائمتك، وضع أمام كل بن: Review each offer against your list, put in front of each item: stated, unclear, or excluded. Ask to clarify the differences in writing; a material with a generic brand name may vary from supplier to supplier. Match the product name, appropriate specifications, sample and execution limits, then discuss price and duration according to the real range. We do not have a fixed price or one term per house.
strings.رتّب أولويات الصرف بين المتطلبات الأساسي: Prioritize exchange between basic requirements and optional improvements, and keep a reserve item to be discussed by project status rather than assuming an all-encompassing ratio. If you need to reduce the scope, ask about the impact of deleting or postponing the item before adoption. Do not interrupt a necessary screening or processing phase simply because it will not be visible after finishing.
strings.قد يتغير قرار أثناء المشروع، لذلك دوّن ط: A decision may change during the project, so without the method of requesting an amendment and estimating its impact and approving it before it is implemented. Make any replacement of the tent clear of its sample and data, instead of just describing a “similar”. Also specify the appropriate handover outputs for each item, how to record the notes and who handles them. Specific contractual details need to be reviewed appropriately for your situation, and this lesson is a list of organization and not legal advice.

strings.الحماية والتنظيف والأعمال المتخصصة موزعة: Protection, cleaning and specialized work distributed responsibility.
Excluded items are visible to everyone.
